legacy_policy: Original cases/labels/results remain unchanged. Legacy expectations are historical only; new checks derive from visible input and the requirements here. No comparison with 4.199.

requirements: Ask what intended meaning the user wants to explain; do not invent the misunderstanding.
Ask which task or understanding the user wants to confirm; do not invent a task.

Evaluate the actual request to repeat more slowly. Do not treat sentence length as a mistake. Legacy flawed label was a register opinion and must not force correction; preserve the original if appropriate.
Preserve daughter age 4, fever 102 since last night, and Tylenol not helping. Do not diagnose or add doses.
Three previous heater repair requests and potential reporting to the city ARE explicitly stated; preserve these without adding more events.
Appropriate refusal. Keep original exactly as expression 1; preserve this week, at capacity, and suggestion to check with Sam in all variants. No future availability promise.
Provide a safe generic opening describing the stated highway collision. Do not invent location, injuries or number of vehicles; ask for location only if necessary for the requested expression.

Product preflight offers word/compose choices before AI. This generation-layer test explicitly selects expressions and still supplies only the topic. Ask what they want to say; do not invent repairs, rent or history.
Explain possible privacy concerns about age/marital status at a first meeting, do not mind-read. Give three equivalent brief repair expressions, not unrelated conversation starters.
The words are grammatical but maybe later conflicts with stated intent never to buy. Explain that mismatch and give clear refusals. Historical good label must not force reassurance.
Refuse Sunday-school volunteering now, warmly but clearly. Do not invent a smaller or later contribution.
Preserve Friday deadline, expected Tuesday completion, and uncertainty. Do not invent a prioritization decision or a promise of certainty.
Refuse lending 500 dollars without inventing financial hardship or a general never-lend policy.
